description: Structure for a list page: header with one primary action, a search and filter toolbar, and rows on a card.
docs: A template from MACAW 0.1.0. Components come from @macaw-ds/ui and stay on the upgrade path; this composition is yours to edit.

block.name: List
block.purpose: Structure for a list page: header with one primary action, a search and filter toolbar, and rows on a card.
block.description: A PageHeader, a toolbar row with a labelled search Input and a Filter button, and the list region on a layer-1 Card with no padding. Placeholder rows are a semantic ul laid out on the 12-column grid with Text and Badge. Renders the main area only: AppShell, TopBar and main come from the root layout.
whenToUse: A collection the user scans, searches and filters: invoices, customers, payouts.
Rows with a name, a status and one figure.
whenNotToUse: Comparing many columns of numbers: wait for the Table component instead of faking one with a grid.
A single record: use the record template.
rules: Render inside AppShell's main; never add a second main or a TopBar.
The PageHeader title is the page's only h1.
At most one primary Button on the page, in the PageHeader actions.
The search Input needs an aria-label (or a visible label).
Keep the list a semantic ul with one li per row; amounts use Text numeric with align end.
